description: Your Zotero library contains 30 papers from an unstructured bulk import, all dumped into a flat collection called 'Unsorted Import'. The papers span decades of scholarship from the 1930s to the 2020s across social sciences, philosophy, and humanities. To make the library navigable, you need to create a hierarchical collection structure. Create a top-level collection called 'Research Archive' containing four subcollections: 'Pre-1960', '1960-1999', '2000-2010', and 'Post-2010'. Move every paper from 'Unsorted Import' into the appropriate subcollection based on its publication year. A paper published in exactly 2010 belongs in '2000-2010'; a paper published in 2011 or later belongs in 'Post-2010'. Once all papers have been reorganized, delete the now-empty 'Unsorted Import' collection.
